result_text:
I made the sub-landscapes row tolerate a missing or unreadable `config.json`. I compiled the `reports` module, which succeeded. I didn't run any tests and didn't try a landscape run with a missing config.

The fix is in `reports/.../landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, at the row-rendering code (line 653). `getSubLandscapeConfig` already catches the read error and returns `null`, and the next line then dereferenced it. If the config or its metadata is `null`, the row now falls back to an empty `Metadata`. That has no logo link, so the row shows the default landscape logo (the `landscape.png` icon). The link to the index page is unchanged.

Sub-landscapes that do have a config go through the same code as before and keep their own logo.
